shots.text: Truline sells through 500 partners with 64 account managers. Only 50 get a dedicated one, and 200 get nobody. We're changing that.
One governed engine on Snowflake, with Claude doing the work. Noah covers 19 partners: the agent ranks 279 plays, routes each to the right rep, and one click approves and logs them.
Claude writes the internal brief and the partner version, every number cited.
Then it checks the news against each play.
Partners nobody covers get a monthly report.
Each user sees only their own data.
A made-up number? Blocked and logged.
Every number sourced, every action audited.
